name: ContraNeRF
definition: A generalizable neural radiance field method that improves synthetic-to-real novel view synthesis by introducing geometry-aware contrastive learning to learn multi-view consistent features with geometric constraints, and cross-view attention to enhance geometry perception.
summary: ContraNeRF is a generalizable neural radiance field method that improves synthetic-to-real novel view synthesis by using geometry-aware contrastive learning and cross-view attention to enforce multi-view consistency without per-scene optimization.
